findings.highlight: The man’s lance that I couldn’t even see is thrown with even more power.
findings.evidenceJa: 男の槍は、さらに勢いを増して少女へと繰り出される
findings.governingReading: The man drives or thrusts his lance at Saber with still greater force.
findings.explanation: Thrown changes a close-range series of controlled thrusts into releasing the weapon.

findings.highlight: it would take such force just to block it.
findings.evidenceJa: あんなもの、受けるだけでも相当な衝撃になる。
findings.governingReading: Merely receiving or blocking such a blow would subject the defender to tremendous impact.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the force to the defender’s required effort rather than to the impact Saber’s blow inflicts.

findings.highlight: You only need to beat down
findings.evidenceJa: 斬り伏せるのではなく叩き伏せるのみ
findings.governingReading: Against an opponent forced onto defense, Saber’s answer is not to cut him down but simply batter him down.
findings.explanation: The English removes the contrast between cutting and crushing that defines the quality of her overwhelming attack.

findings.highlight: the girl uses her whole body to execute her blow
findings.evidenceJa: 体ごとなぎ払う少女の一撃
findings.governingReading: Saber uses her whole body to sweep Lancer away in one strike.
findings.explanation: The English retains whole-body force but deletes the sweeping direction that resolves the previous rotation.

findings.highlight: The two stare at each other silently.
findings.evidenceJa: 今の攻防は互いに負担が大きかったのか、両者は静かに睨み合っている。
findings.governingReading: Perhaps because the exchange heavily taxed both fighters, they now glare at each other in silence.
findings.explanation: The English removes the mutual physical cost that explains the pause and tactical reset.

findings.evidenceJa: オレのマスターとて姿をさらせねえ大腑抜けときた
findings.governingReading: My own Master is an utter coward who cannot even show himself.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only cowardice and removes the concealment that creates the claimed imbalance between the two Masters.

findings.highlight: is bleeding badly from her chest
findings.evidenceJa: その胸を貫かれ、[ruby text=おびただ]夥しいまでの血を流していた
findings.governingReading: Saber appears to have her chest pierced and is losing a tremendous amount of blood.
findings.explanation: Bleeding from her chest removes the apparent penetration that the causality explanation immediately analyzes.

findings.highlight: enough divine protection to nullify the curse of the lance
findings.evidenceJa: 槍の呪いを緩和するだけの加護
findings.governingReading: Perhaps Saber had protection sufficient to mitigate the lance’s curse.
findings.explanation: Nullify claims complete cancellation even though the attack pierced and deeply wounded her; the source says only mitigation.

findings.evidenceJa: アイルランドの光の御子
findings.governingReading: The formal title identifies him as Ireland’s Child of Light.
findings.explanation: Man of light mistranslates the established kinship title 御子 and weakens Saber’s moment of mythic recognition.
